summary.summary: Of 100 synthetic agents asked whether the TTC should raise the adult fare by 50 cents per ride while keeping the Fair Pass fare unchanged, 75 (75%) opposed, 18 (18%) were neutral and 7 (7%) supported, with none choosing either strong option. Most said they would be affected only "a little" (72%) or "not at all" (28%), but many opposed it anyway; one agent said "a fare hike lands hardest on people who depend on transit every day." A neutral daily rider said "I'd rather the TTC get the money it needs as long as the Fair Pass stays protected for people who can't afford the adult fare." These are survey-style reactions from synthetic agents, not forecasts, and this data includes no world runs (simulations of synthetic agents in a schematic world).
